neighbours.label: Describing muscle fiber proteins and sarcomere organization, including troponin as a cardiac marker
fire: After stimulation, troponin binds calcium and allows tropomyosin to expose binding sites along the actin filament.
In suspected myocardial injury, serial troponin concentrations increased sharply despite an initially normal electrocardiogram.
Within each sarcomere, thin actin filaments attach to Z discs while thick myosin filaments occupy the central region.
Microscopy revealed densely packed myofibrils and the repeating bands characteristic of striated skeletal muscle.
During processing, heating altered the solubility of myofibrillar and sarcoplasmic proteins in chicken breast.
In relaxed muscle, tropomyosin blocks the sites where myosin heads would otherwise bind along the thin filament.
During contraction, the thick and thin strands slide past each other, bringing the boundaries of each repeating unit closer together.
In muscular dystrophy, loss of dystrophin weakens the connection between the muscle fiber membrane and its internal cytoskeleton.
quiet: Within migrating epithelial cells, actin polymerization pushes the leading edge forward and supports the formation of broad membrane protrusions.
During evaluation for heart failure, elevated brain natriuretic peptide supported the finding of increased ventricular wall stress.
At the neuromuscular junction, acetylcholine opens receptor channels and initiates an electrical impulse along the muscle surface.
The biopsy showed extensive fatty replacement of skeletal muscle, with scattered inflammatory cells surrounding small blood vessels.
During refrigerated storage, bacterial growth on chicken breast increased rapidly after the packaging seal was damaged.
Under polarized light, the striated mineral crystals displayed repeated bright bands throughout the geological specimen.
During passive stretching, the tendon lengthened slightly and stored elastic energy before returning to its original shape.
For a family affected by muscular dystrophy, genetic counseling addressed inheritance patterns and the probability of recurrence in future pregnancies.
